record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare TERRAIN_PULSE: Smoliv (1 star), Dolliv (2 stars), Arboliva (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the caster's star count (table index) and maxPP/range as listed. Units sharing the identifier but not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs no target. After the PP spend, a caster without a terrain field gives itself grassField. Every same-team unit that already holds a field (caster included) is found; each same-team neighbour (8 cells) that holds no field receives one of the adjacent field types, chosen at random among the types around it (fields spread one step only, from the snapshot taken before spreading). Then every ally holding a field (the originals and the newly fielded) gets a bonus chosen by the field it reads first in the order fairy, electric, grass, psychic: grass heals a fraction of its max HP, electric adds speed, psychic adds PP, fairy adds a shield of a fraction of its max HP; all bonuses use the caster's star-indexed table and are AP-scaled (apBoost 1) with the crit flag.

targeting.who: the caster's team: field holders after spreading (including the caster); no enemy is affected
targeting.note: Spread goes from field holders to adjacent same-team units that hold no field; the bonus step applies to every same-team unit holding a field after spreading, not only to the newly fielded ones.

effects.resolution: Collected for all holders before any change (snapshot); one pickRandomIn over the set of adjacent field types; applied through addFairyField / addElectricField / addGrassField / addPsychicField. Electric and psychic add +30 speed for SURGE_SURFER units. Newly fielded units do not spread further in the same cast.

effects.target: each ally whose field reads grassField

declaredRaw.unit: fraction of the ally's max HP

effects.scaling: requested = fraction x the ally's own maxHP (not the caster's). handleHeal(requested, caster, apBoost 1, crit): x(1 + caster AP/100), x critPower on crit, x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burning, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH, rounded.
effects.resolution: requested (fraction x maxHP) -> applied (after AP / crit / modifiers, rounded) -> healReceived (capped by the ally's missing HP). A wounded or protected ally receives 0.

effects.target: each ally whose field reads electricField
effects.scaling: requested = table value. addSpeed(requested, caster, apBoost 1, crit): Big Eater Belt on the receiver first (x1.25, rounded down, positive values), then x(1 + caster AP/100) x critPower on crit.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit) -> speed clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED. Melmetal turns the speed gain into half the amount as attack instead. Twist Band does not matter for a positive value.

effects.target: each ally whose field reads psychicField
effects.scaling: requested = table value. addPP(requested, caster, apBoost 1, crit): x(1 + caster AP/100) x critPower on crit x0.5 under fatigue, rounded.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> applied (after AP / crit / fatigue, rounded) -> not applied while the ally is silenced, protected, resurrecting or under NO_PP_GAIN; clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1.

effects.target: each ally whose field reads fairyField

declaredRaw.unit: fraction of the ally's max HP

effects.scaling: requested = fraction x the ally's own maxHP. addShield: Big Eater Belt on the receiver first (x1.25, rounded down with 0 digits, positive values), then x(1 + caster AP/100), x critPower on crit, x0.5 when the ally is enraged, rounded.
effects.resolution: requested (fraction x maxHP) -> applied (after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged, rounded) -> added to the ally's shield (no cap). Skipped if the ally has no HP.

statusEffects.effect: grassField / fairyField / electricField / psychicField flags set on allies; separate from the bonus step. Each holder deals x1.2 damage per field flag it holds (handleDamage checks each flag), including the caster's own grassField.
field flags are cleared by clearPositiveStatus and by the terrain passives' removal code; no duration or cooldown is attached in the status add methods

starBehavior.note: all four tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (not the receiving ally's); the 4-star entries are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Spreading only reaches same-team units directly adjacent (8 neighbours) to a field holder that has no field itself. An isolated ally far from every holder gets no field and no bonus. An ally that already holds a field is not changed by spreading but still gets its bonus.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Field flags persist on the units (no duration is set in the add methods read), so on a later cast units fielded earlier count as holders and get their bonus again, and spreading continues one more step from them. An ally holding several fields gets only the bonus of the first in the order fairy, electric, grass, psychic.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: heal and shield 5/7/10 % of the receiving ally's max HP; speed and PP 10/12/15 (1/2/3 stars). Requested = raw (the percentages times that ally's maxHP). Applied = after the receiving ally's Big Eater Belt (speed, shield), caster AP, crit, fatigue (PP), enraged (shield) and the heal modifiers; received/effective = after the missing-HP cap (heal), MAX_SPEED clamp (speed) or PP clamp.
